% Synthetic fixture: the no-companion branch of math-face resolution. No
% \fonts math key and no designed companion for the body family — the
% first installed face with an OpenType MATH table serves (under the
% documented family-alphabetical order), named once (N0016).
\documentclass{article}
\fonts{ dir = "fonts", body = "Source Serif Pro" }

\begin{document}

\section{A Body With No Companion}

A serif with no designed math companion still gets working formulas: the
quadratic $x^2 + 2x + 1$ renders as glyphs, and so does the display

\[ \frac{a + b}{c} \]

with its bar from the resolved face's own constants.

\end{document}
